intro: Covers lessons 5 to 9 of Computer systems and architecture. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Which is application software?
questions.a: B) A web browser. A browser does a task for the user; the others manage the computer (system software).

questions.q: Which register holds the address of the next instruction?
questions.a: B) Program counter. The PC points to the next instruction; the MDR holds the data fetched; the ALU is not a register.

questions.q: Which memory loses its contents when the power is off?
questions.a: C) RAM. RAM is volatile; ROM, SSD and DVD keep their data.

questions.q: How many bits are in 3 bytes?
Which utility makes a file smaller to email it?
questions.a: B) Compression. Compression reduces file size; the others protect or organise files.

questions.q: Is a touchscreen input, output or both? Explain.
questions.a: Both: it detects touches (input) and displays images (output).
questions.model: Teacher asks two questions of the device: does data go in? yes, touches. Does data come out? yes, the display. So both.
